body:
Found while planning #650 (eduralph/pdca-pdca Plan session, 2026-10-10). Code references are `main` @ `b5f5c29`.

**What happens.** Under `[driver].wave_mode = "merge"`, publish refuses a PR whose base is a branch the run produced (#411, `_merge_base_refusal`, `template/src/pdca_harness/publish.py:752`, called at `:289`). A bundle with an `Onto branch` brief field never reaches that guard. `publish.publish` hands it to `_publish_stacked` and returns before the check (`publish.py:225-228`). `_publish_stacked` adds a commit to an EXISTING open PR, which may be someone else's PR with any base, and records that PR's URL with `"mode": "stacked"` (`publish.py:539-547`).

In merge mode, `merge._merge_one` then treats that PR like any other. It reads `pr_url` from the record (`merge.py:374-376`), runs `gh pr ready` on it (`:396-397`), and `gh pr merge` merges it into whatever base it has. `merge.py` never looks at the record's mode. So an unattended merge-mode run can mark ready and merge a pre-existing PR the bundle only added one commit to, along with everything else on that PR. Nobody approved that.

The fold already treats an `Onto branch` record as "may have merged into a base other than" the target (`integrate.py:519-527`), and `merged.merged_into` never counts one as merged (`merged.py:104-110`). Only merge mode trusts it.

**Fix, one of:**
- refuse the `Onto branch` + `wave_mode = "merge"` combination up front, at publish (before any push) or when the batch is scheduled; or
- have `merge._merge_one` refuse a `"stacked"` record, with a message that says why, and leave the PR as it is.

**Done when** a merge-mode run never readies or merges the PR behind an `Onto branch` record, and a test pins it: a COMPLETE bundle with a `"stacked"` `publish.json` in a non-final merge-mode wave, with `gh pr ready` / `gh pr merge` never called.

Related: #411 (the merge-mode base guard), #650 (merge mode cannot fetch a third remote, which only matters for exactly these records).
title: merge mode: an `Onto branch` bundle skips the #411 base guard, so merge mode can ready and merge a pre-existing PR
